images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / reference-grounded marketing composition.
Create ONE polished 1600x1000 product artwork for the Kayak website, using LINEAR'S EDITORIAL COMPOSITION rather than a complete App screenshot.
Reference image 1 is the exact COMPOSITION/style authority: use its LOWER product illustration only. A large dominant foreground conversation fragment overlaps a lower-contrast broader workspace fragment behind it; outer edges dissolve into near-black. Ignore its navigation and English section headings.
Reference image 2 is the authentic KAYAK native UI/content authority: source its Chinese system sans-serif, charcoal surfaces, folder icons, selected project row, actual conversation text and restrained native styling.
The purpose is to selectively compose areas of ONE coherent task "准备产品发布", not to display three unrelated features.
Composition: three connected visual layers, all flat and front-facing, with clear size and contrast hierarchy. The big conversation is the main focus, about 60% of the artwork. A muted project-context fragment peeks from its upper-left/rear. A small resulting document preview connects from the conversation's lower-right and overlaps its edge. The layers must visibly overlap to form one intentional silhouette and continuous story, not three equally sized floating windows. Take inspiration from the native thread foreground and wider rear workspace in reference 1. Use moderate controlled black negative space, not a symmetric card grid. Let parts of the rear workspace and the bottom extend beyond the artwork crop.
Rear context fragment: a selectively cropped flat native project list, showing "项目", folder "网站", selected task "准备产品发布", and one secondary "调研" folder. No traffic lights, no full desktop sidebar from top to bottom, no user footer, no separate new rounded sidebar card. It belongs to a larger workspace plane and recedes in contrast.
Dominant foreground conversation fragment: slim native title row with folder icon and "准备产品发布". One user bubble reads exactly "整理产品发布前的检查清单，包含官网、资料和渠道。". Native assistant heading "官网与产品体验", then only two clear bullet lines "核对首屏信息、产品演示和下载入口" and "检查桌面与移动端的布局". Native gray composer edge can partially crop at the bottom. Use large crisp text, around 26-30px equivalent at 1600 width. Do not duplicate the whole App shell.
Small lower-right result fragment: a native document preview titled "发布检查清单.md", showing a few clean short checklist rows "官网与下载入口", "产品介绍与截图", "发布渠道与资料". This result directly answers the same task. Use thin gray line separators, flat surface and no invented decorative chart, badge, metric or tool.
Styling: authentic Kayak gray-black product UI with Linear's composition, flat near-black #08090a background, charcoal #141516 and #1b1c1e surfaces, muted 1px borders, restrained 10-12px corner radius, one consistent Chinese type scale. The foreground is clearest; rear context 30% lower contrast; document result slightly subordinate. Foreground overlaps should feel purposeful and visually connected.
Framing/fades: central UI remains sharp. A single coherent fade at the extreme left, extreme right and lower 18% melts the whole composition into black. No internal blurry seams or mismatched light. No tilt or perspective.
CRITICAL: do not output one complete rectangular App window. No macOS traffic lights, no full device, no repeated logos. Show SELECTIVE native UI fragments with hierarchy, overlap, cropping and breathing space.
Avoid 3D blocks, glass, glow, neon, physical objects, stock photo avatars, top marketing text, full web page, isometric view, equal-sized card layout, three disconnected floating windows, huge shadows, unrelated content, Linear/Slack branding, watermark.
Output only the finished composed Kayak product illustration.

images.label: 电脑控制 · 超宽工作面
images.prompt:
Create ONE dark Kayak software marketing illustration, landscape 1600x1000.
Reference image 1 is the EXACT COMPOSITION authority, using only its product artwork, NOT its website navigation or page copy. Reference image 2 supplies authentic Kayak UI language/content only.
Prioritize graphic composition, scale contrast, silhouette and rhythm. UI may be substantially overlapped, cut off, obscured and unreadable. Do NOT preserve whole screens just to show every word. This artwork is visual design, not a readable tutorial.
Shared visual language: flat near-black #08090a background, native charcoal UI, thin subdued gray boundaries, restrained Chinese system sans-serif, small genuine UI accent colors only, edges softly disappearing into black. Straight-on flat planes, no 3D, perspective, glass, glow, physical devices, photography of people or watermark.
Exclude website headers and marketing headlines from the output.
COMPOSITION IS THE WIDE WORK-SURFACE ARRANGEMENT OF LINEAR BUILD (reference 1): a quieter working/source surface behind on the LEFT, and an OVERSIZED LANDSCAPE content plane in front starting about 32% across the frame, extending PAST THE RIGHT EDGE by roughly 20%. Use TWO overlapping planes only. Strong horizontal sweep, not a centered conversation window.
Adapt the reference's left working list to a cropped browser/source workspace from reference 2: subdued native browser toolbar and partial "产品资料" supplier website with a small pointer on a navigation link. Enough activity cues to suggest visiting sources. Most of it may be covered.
Replace the reference's giant code diff with an equally wide, carefully gridded native spreadsheet/artifact preview "供应商对比.xlsx". Dominant horizontal rows, muted grid lines, columns "供应商", "产品方向", "交付信息", "资料来源"; 4-5 demo rows with labels "示例 A", "示例 B", "示例 C", "示例 D", "待确认", "官网". The grid can be partly cut off beyond the right edge; its linework and width are the graphic focus. Use a tiny native document/file tab at top; do not invent colorful charts. A few short muted Chinese lines are enough. The foreground plane covers more than half of the source workspace, exactly like Linear's very wide diff overlaps its list.
Keep source and foreground tonal hierarchy and boundaries close to reference 1. Let the lower third gradually disappear into black. No full App shell or sidebar. NO chat bubbles, NO centered chat window, NO third result card in lower-right, NO floating document/checklist card. The spreadsheet IS the main wide foreground surface, not a small accessory. The image must look structurally very different from a three-card stack.
